import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int R, C, N;
    static char[] S; // 1-indexed
    static long[][] comb;
    static int[] prefA, prefB;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] good, bad;
    static final int MAX = 66;

    static void init_comb() {
        comb = new long[MAX][MAX];
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j];
        }
    }

    static long diff(int mask, int a0, int b0) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < C + 1; ++i) {
            if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                ++b0;
                long t1 = comb[b0 - 1][R - 1];
                long t2 = comb[N - b0][R] - comb[a0][R];
                res -= t1 * t2;
            } else {
                ++a0;
                long t1 = comb[a0 - 1][R - 1];
                long t2 = comb[N - a0][R] - comb[b0][R];
                res += t1 * t2;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static boolean valid(int mask) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C + 1; ++i) {
            if (S[2 * R + C + i] == 'A' && ((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) return false;
            if (S[2 * R + C + i] == 'B' && ((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void build_second() {
        int limit = 1 << (C + 1);
        good = new ArrayList[C + 2];
        bad = new ArrayList[C + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= C + 1; ++i) {
            good[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            bad[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < limit; ++mask) {
            int bcnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            int acnt = C + 1 - bcnt;
            long val = diff(mask, R + C - acnt, R + C - bcnt);
            if (valid(mask))
                good[acnt].add(val);
            else
                bad[acnt].add(val);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= C + 1; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(good[i]);
            Collections.sort(bad[i]);
        }
    }

    static long coeff(int mask) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = 0; i < C + 1; ++i)
            if (((mask >> i) & 1) != (mask & 1))
                break;
        for (j = i; j < C + 1; ++j) {
            if (S[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'A' && ((mask >> j) & 1) != 0) return 0;
            if (S[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'B' && ((mask >> j) & 1) == 0) return 0;
        }
        int setA = R - 1 + ((mask & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int setB = R - 1 + ((mask & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
        if (setA < prefA[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (setB < prefB[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return comb[setA + setB - prefA[2 * R - 2 + i] - prefB[2 * R - 2 + i]][setA - prefA[2 * R - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void update(long[] best, long curVal, long curCnt) {
        if (curVal < 0) curVal = -curVal;
        if (best[0] < curVal) return;
        if (best[0] > curVal) {
            best[0] = curVal;
            best[1] = curCnt;
            return;
        }
        best[1] += curCnt;
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Long> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    static int upperBound(ArrayList<Long> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) <= key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    static long countVal(ArrayList<Long> v, long x) {
        int lo = lowerBound(v, x);
        int hi = upperBound(v, x);
        return hi - lo;
    }

    static long first_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (C + 1);
        long[] best = new long[]{Long.MAX_VALUE, 0};
        for (int mask = 0; mask < limit; ++mask) {
            int bcnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            int acnt = C + 1 - bcnt;
            long cur = diff(mask, R - 1, R - 1);
            long cf = coeff(mask);
            ArrayList<Long> g = good[C + 1 - acnt];
            int it = lowerBound(g, -cur);
            if (it < g.size()) {
                long val = g.get(it);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = countVal(g, val);
                    update(best, val + cur, cf * cnt);
                }
            }
            if (it > 0) {
                --it;
                long val = g.get(it);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = countVal(g, val);
                    update(best, val + cur, cf * cnt);
                }
            }
            cf = 0;
            ArrayList<Long> b = bad[C + 1 - acnt];
            it = lowerBound(b, -cur);
            if (it < b.size()) {
                long val = b.get(it);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = countVal(b, val);
                    update(best, val + cur, cf * cnt);
                }
            }
            if (it > 0) {
                --it;
                long val = b.get(it);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long cnt = countVal(b, val);
                    update(best, val + cur, cf * cnt);
                }
            }
        }
        return best[1];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        N = 2 * (R + C);
        S = new char[N + 2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            S[i] = s.charAt(i - 1);
        }
        init_comb();
        prefA = new int[N + 1];
        prefB = new int[N + 1];
        for (int idx = 1; idx <= N; ++idx) {
            prefA[idx] = prefA[idx-1] + (S[idx] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            prefB[idx] = prefB[idx-1] + (S[idx] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        build_second();
        long sol = first_part();
        System.out.println(sol);
        sc.close();
    }
}
